open.thesis: Team 13 roster Josh Allen and Lamar Jackson in a one-QB league — their second quarterback scores them nothing every week. Behind McCaffrey their backs are White (8.9) and Corum (9.4). Both sides gain: me +1.5, them +2.6.
open.falsifiedIf: They trade one quarterback elsewhere, or they acquire a starting back, which removes the surplus that makes this work.

open.thesis: Bowers had a meniscus trim and is out one to two weeks. Mayer is Las Vegas' TE1 and was just extended three years. The IPADE flex takes a tight end, so a second startable TE has real value here.
open.falsifiedIf: Bowers returns and Mayer's route share drops back under about 50%.

open.thesis: Starts over Stafford from week 2. Ranked QB8 against Stafford's unranked, and Stafford is 38 coming off a career-high touchdown rate that will regress.
open.falsifiedIf: The Lamar trade lands, which makes Lawrence expendable, or Stafford strings together two clearly better weeks.

closed.summary: The kicker slot went Little -> Boswell on 8 Sep and Boswell -> Little on 10 Sep. The same slot reversed in two days for no stated reason. This is the clearest example of optimising noise on the record.
Allgeier added 8 Sep, dropped 10 Sep. Two days on the roster, no stated thesis either way.
